reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel mortgage / lending-authority rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary / framework-mapping. KYE already governs lending & credit-decision authority via kye:rule-pack:agentic-lending + kye:sector-pack:agentic-lending + kye:dictionary:agentic-lending, bound to ECOA / Regulation B / FCRA / fair-lending / FCA Consumer Duty / MCOB. A parallel pack is a §0 competing-systems violation; re-mapping the frameworks is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:rule-pack:agentic-lending verdict under KYE authority, strictly secured home-loan / mortgage origination. Add only the agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, kye-mortgage-lending-action-authority-agent ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing frameworks via kye:rule-pack:agentic-lending + kye:dictionary:agentic-lending.
